proposed_submission_copy_pending_exact_c.reviewer_instructions: No account is needed. Open https://www.aimatrx.com/matrx-extend-demo and click the toolbar icon. In Scrape, click Capture; in SEO, confirm the audit. In Chat ask "What are the three workflow stages on this page?" Expect Capture, Understand, and Use. Guest AI offers limited free tries. With a regular non-admin account, sign in: Chat stays available and signed-in tabs, including Swipe file, appear. Automatic page capture is off on a fresh install.
proposed_submission_copy_pending_exact_c.listing_description_addition: Signed-in users can save a supported social post or ad from the page they are viewing into a Swipe file collection, then review available media and transcripts. A visit alone never saves a post.
proposed_submission_copy_pending_exact_c.privacy_field_delta: The live October 15 extension policy already discloses user-chosen Swipe post URL submission, possible external social-data provider retrieval, shared cache retention, and signed-in configuration-read reporting with local queued records and no raw setting values, page content or visited-site list. Before submission, verify the primary dashboard's Website content, User activity and Personally identifiable information selections and purpose/third-party declarations still truthfully cover these flows; no new category is established from source review alone.
proposed_submission_copy_pending_exact_c.screenshots: Keep Swipe Save out of reviewer steps and screenshots until exact candidate native Save/review has passed. Check the four existing guest screenshots against the exact candidate UI before reuse.
